how: On the package page click Report malware, fill in the form with all affected versions, and Send Report.
Sign in, open the project page, click Report project as malware at the bottom of the sidebar, and link the bad lines via inspector.pypi.io. security@pypi.org is only for flaws in PyPI itself.
Repository About sidebar > Report repository, or the ... menu > Report content, or the abuse contact form.
Email openvsx@eclipse-foundation.org; registry vulnerabilities go through eclipse.org/security.
On the extension's Marketplace page, use Report a concern at the bottom of the More Info section.
Signed in, click Report skill on the skill page; packages use the package reporting command/API (not named in docs).
Report through Vercel's coordinated disclosure process and include the skill URL.
Report abuse to the underlying package registry (npm, PyPI, Docker Hub) and open a GitHub issue titled 'Abuse report: ...'.
Repository three-dot menu > Report the repository; this opens a public discussion.
